notablePrerequisites:
Gigantoplasm on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Gigantoplasm do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Gigantoplasm.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Gigantoplasm.
Activate Gigantoplasm by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
